description: Active exploitation of a CVSS 9.8 FortiOS zero-day against a global fintech company. No vendor patch available. Production cannot be shut down. Attacker confirmed aware of vulnerability. 7-day patch window. Five concrete tasks must be answered.

assets.note: HA failover is an attacker-reachable pivot path
K8s Ingress reachable from compromised firewall network segment
IMDS version unknown — blast radius from container escape unverified
GitHub OIDC tokens may be stealable if pipeline network path crosses compromised segment
SAML assertion forgery possible if FortiGate SSL inspection terminates Okta traffic
5-minute blind window covers full exploit-to-backdoor lifecycle (exploit_window = 3 min)

tasks: T1: Enumerate all attack paths originating from a FortiGate firewall compromise — include K8s Ingress pivot, AWS IAM via IMDS hop, Okta SAML abuse, GitHub OIDC theft, and lateral movement via HA failover
T2: Propose compensating controls that do not require patching and keep production running — all controls must be expressed as USAP intent blocks, no raw CLI
T3: Classify all proposed controls as IMMEDIATE (0-24h) or DEFERRED (24h-7d) with explicit rationale for each timeline bucket
T4: Determine how to verify whether the FortiGate firewall has already been compromised — existing_compromise_status is UNKNOWN, do not assume clean
T5: Produce a 7-day risk assessment showing daily residual risk posture and how it changes as controls are applied
